channel.title: The Brussels Times
channel.description: Latest posts from The Brussels Times.

item.title: 'Large-scale strikes': Russia threatens foreign diplomats and nationals in Kyiv
item.description: Russia on Saturday again urged its diplomats and foreign nationals to leave Kyiv.

item.title: North Korean military fired ballistic missile with integrated AI
item.description: Country's officials claimed the missile could adjust its trajectory at low altitude and that AI had been integrated into the system.

item.title: New tiny frog species discovered in Ecuador
item.description: The amphibian measures just between 15.1 and 18.3 millimetres in length.

item.title: Starbucks under pressure over new locations in Chinese province with Uyghur human rights violations
item.description: Chair of US House special committee on China described the move as “shocking and morally bankrupt”.

item.title: Aquaculture harms fish, oceans, and food security, says new report
item.description: “EU decisionmakers have a blind spot when it comes to acknowledging fish farming’s impact on European fisheries."

item.title: EU's climate monitoring sees record heat stress during hottest summer
item.description: A record 52% of Europe was exposed to very strong heat stress during this year’s exceptionally hot summer, EU's climate observatory Copernicus said on Friday.

item.title: Inflation across eurozone climbs to three-year high
item.description: Inflation in the eurozone accelerated to 3.8% in September, driven by rising energy prices and reaching its highest level in three years.

item.title: Danish company to build world's largest jewellery factory in Vietnam
item.description: Pandora, the world’s largest jewellery brand, opened a production site in Ho Chi Minh City on Thursday, investing $150 million in a factory expected to create 7,000 jobs.

item.title: Belgian universities slip down higher education ranking
item.description: KU Leuven ranks 45th globally, obtaining its highest ranking since 2016.

item.title: EU halts Sierra Leone aid over harbouring of infamous Dutch drug lord
item.description: The European Commission has immediately halted payments to Sierra Leone because of the presence of fugitive drug kingpin Jos Leijdekkers, known as Bolle Jos.

item.title: US Defense Secretary gives Elon Musk position within Pentagon
item.description: Earlier in August, Wall Street Journal reported that Musk agreed to donate at least $100 million to the Republicans.

item.title: Global agricultural prices rising fastest since 2022
item.description: A Bloomberg index tracking 10 major crops, from soya beans to coffee, climbed 13% over last quarter.

item.title: Belgium orders surface-to-air missile systems from Norwegian firm Kongsberg
item.description: Norwegian defence company Kongsberg has signed a contract worth around €918 million to supply Belgium with the NASAMS air defence system.

item.title: Flight from Dubai to Israel lands in Saudi Arabia after crash attempt
item.description: "A passenger describes harrowing scenes when the plane dropped height sharply."

item.title: Cargo ship stranded in Düsseldorf due to low water levels
item.description: Drought and low rainfall have left water levels in the Rhine unusually low, forcing cargo ships to reduce loads and causing some ferries to suspend services.

item.title: Only two EU countries tax diesel more heavily than Belgium
item.description: According to the Commission’s calculations, 42.5% of the average price per litre paid by diesel drivers in Belgium last week went towards various government taxes.

item.title: FIFA accuses UEFA of spreading misinformation about World Cup sale
item.description: FIFA has accused UEFA of spreading misinformation about the plan to allow private investors to acquire parts of the World Cup.

item.title: Six leaders of European countries set EU budget ultimatum
item.description: The Netherlands, Germany, and four other countries have issued an ultimatum to the EU over the budget, demanding cuts of hundreds of billions in spending.

item.title: US Ambassador promises investments of up to €20 billion in Belgium
item.description: US ambassador to Belgium Bill White expects American companies to invest €15 to €20 billion in the Belgian economy according to a statement made Monday evening.

item.title: Trump announces building of biggest steel plant in US history
item.description: The steel plant which Mesabi Metallics plans to begin building by 2030 in Iowa, USA, according to the US president, is pricetagged at about €13.2 billion.
